reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333 , looks good, a few small remarks:

1. **Overlap with #2279**: nothing to do here. Once this is merged, I'll rebase #2279, make the opt-out win over the level, and add integration tests for the combined case.
2. **Warning**: "cannot be declared to disable thinking" reads oddly. It also fires for the flash-lite models, which have no flag and don't think by default, so "default thinking applies" is wrong there. Either give them `can_be_disabled: true` (budget 0 is accepted on them in the #2259 measurements), or use a separate message when the flag is missing.
3. **Nit**: `LoggerFactory` is already imported; `ConcurrentHashMap` could be an import too.
4. **Docs**: the Google GenAI section of `thinking/page.adoc` could mention `thinking.can_be_disabled`.

@pcbeingused333 Thanks, the remarks are addressed in 93d0adc.

I ran the same ITs on  key and Vertex credentials: all 44 pass. Your errors came from your account, not the code:

- **429**: free-tier quota.
- **404 on 2.5 models**: Google no longer serves them to new users. `GoogleGenAiToolResponseIT` still uses `gemini-2.5-flash`, hence your 4/4 errors. It passes here because I still has access with my pro account (will stop working on 1 dec 2026)
- **Vertex**: `BlankTurnRePromptIT` hard-codes `us-central1`, where `gemini-3.8-flash` isn't available. It passes with `global`. Unrelated to this PR, I'll fix it separately.

None of the existing ITs calls `withoutThinking()`, so I wrote one that runs every catalog model against the real API, with both the API key and Vertex:

- The 4 models with `can_be_disabled: true` think by default and return 0 thought tokens with `withoutThinking()`. Without your fix, they still think (229 thought tokens on `gemini-3.6-flash`).
- The others get no `thinkingBudget`, the call still works, and the warning is logged.

All pass: 16/16 with the API key, 14/16 on Vertex (2 flash-lite models are not served in `global`). I'll push this IT in #2279.

comments.body: @pcbeingused333 - please have PR name starting with a capital letter in the future, thanks

@pcbeingused333 - please confirm execution of IT tests, thank you

Looping @azanux

> **Tests** (no network): `GoogleGenAiOptionsConverterTest` covers opt-out with `declaring(true)` (budget 0), with extraction, `declaring(false)`, undeclared, and unchanged explicit-budget / null / extraction-only paths; `GoogleGenAiModelLoaderTest` reads `can_be_disabled` from YAML. Without the `true` branch the opt-out tests fail.

@pcbeingused333 unit tests are insufficient IMO, thanks

@pcbeingused333 - please be advised that observations from @azanux represent typical code generated by AI .
As such, please use the following as guidance for future contributions:
- always review code, KDOC and docs generated by AI
- accept PR ownership only if you can execute IT tests
- IT logs require careful - most likely manual - verification.

Hope it helps.
Thank you for understanding; the framework can quickly morph into a pile of AI-generated code, which is close to impossible read / understand
Thanks and good luck

Ran the Google GenAI ITs on this branch (`-Pintegration-tests`, `GoogleGenAi*IT` + `BlankTurnRePromptIT`) with a real key. Summary: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingIT 3/3 passed; BlankTurnRePromptIT skipped (1); GoogleGenAiChatIntegrationIT 18 run, 7 errors, 3 skipped; GoogleGenAiToolResponseIT 4/4 errors; GoogleGenAiAllModelsIT did not finish before the 50 min timeout.
All errors are API-side, not assertion failures: 429 (free-tier quota exceeded) and 404 ("gemini-2.5-flash / 2.5-pro / 2.5-flash-lite no longer available to new users"), plus one 503. So with this key the chat/tool/all-models ITs can't give a meaningful result. If someone with a paid key or access to the newer model ids can run them, that would be the real confirmation.

(The IT run and this summary were done with the help of an AI coding agent.)
@pcbeingused333  Thanks for the contribution , please can you fix the small remaks that were flagged, and I'll handle the integration tests.

@azanux thanks. Pushed 93d0adcd0:
- Warning: it now says the opt-out is ignored because `thinking.can_be_disabled` is not true in the catalog entry and no `thinkingBudget` is sent, with no claim about the model's default, so it also holds for the flash-lite entries without the flag. I did not change the flags in the catalog.
- `LoggerFactory` and `ConcurrentHashMap` are imported instead of fully qualified.
- Docs: the Google GenAI section of `thinking/page.adoc` now mentions `thinking.can_be_disabled`.

`GoogleGenAiOptionsConverterTest` and `GoogleGenAiModelLoaderTest` pass (61 tests).

(Prepared with the assistance of an AI coding agent.)

I personally can't make any judgment without reviewing the logs.
